222     def _fix_broken_tool_use(self, messages: list[Message]) -> list[Message]:
223         """Fix broken tool use/result pairs in message history.
224 
225         This method handles two issues:
226         1. Orphaned toolUse messages without corresponding toolResult.
227            Before 1.15.0, strands had a bug where they persisted sessions with a potentially broken messages array.
228            This method retroactively fixes that issue by adding a tool_result outside of session management.
229            After 1.15.0, this bug is no longer present.
230         2. Orphaned toolResult messages without corresponding toolUse (e.g., when pagination truncates messages)
231 
232         Args:
233             messages: The list of messages to fix
234             agent_id: The agent ID for fetching previous messages
235             removed_message_count: Number of messages removed by the conversation manager
236 
237         Returns:
238             Fixed list of messages with proper tool use/result pairs
239         """
240         # First, check if the oldest message has orphaned toolResult (no preceding toolUse) and remove it.
241         if messages:
242             first_message = messages[0]
243             if first_message["role"] == "user" and any("toolResult" in content for content in first_message["content"]):
244                 logger.warning(
245                     "Session message history starts with orphaned toolResult with no preceding toolUse. "
246                     "This typically happens when messages are truncated due to pagination limits. "
247                     "Removing orphaned toolResult message to maintain valid conversation structure."
248                 )
249                 messages.pop(0)
250 
251         # Then check for orphaned toolUse messages
252         for index, message in enumerate(messages):
253             # Check all but the latest message in the messages array
254             # The latest message being orphaned is handled in the agent class
255             if index + 1 < len(messages):
256                 if any("toolUse" in content for content in message["content"]):
257                     tool_use_ids = [
258                         content["toolUse"]["toolUseId"] for content in message["content"] if "toolUse" in content
259                     ]
260 
261                     # Check if there are more messages after the current toolUse message
262                     tool_result_ids = [
263                         content["toolResult"]["toolUseId"]
264                         for content in messages[index + 1]["content"]
265                         if "toolResult" in content
266                     ]
267 
268                     missing_tool_use_ids = list(set(tool_use_ids) - set(tool_result_ids))
269                     # If there are missing tool use ids, that means the messages history is broken
270                     if missing_tool_use_ids:
271                         logger.warning(
272                             "Session message history has an orphaned toolUse with no toolResult. "
273                             "Adding toolResult content blocks to create valid conversation."
274                         )
275                         # Create the missing toolResult content blocks
276                         missing_content_blocks = generate_missing_tool_result_content(missing_tool_use_ids)
277 
278                         if tool_result_ids:
279                             # If there were any toolResult ids, that means only some of the content blocks are missing
280                             messages[index + 1]["content"].extend(missing_content_blocks)
281                         else:
282                             # The message following the toolUse was not a toolResult, so lets insert it
283                             messages.insert(index + 1, {"role": "user", "content": missing_content_blocks})
284         return messages

223         """Fix broken tool use/result pairs in message history.

225         This method handles two issues:

227            Before 1.15.0, strands had a bug where they persisted sessions with a potentially broken messages array.

235             removed_message_count: Number of messages removed by the conversation manager
236

239         """
240         # First, check if the oldest message has orphaned toolResult (no preceding toolUse) and remove it.
241         if messages:
242             first_message = messages[0]
243             if first_message["role"] == "user" and any("toolResult" in content for content in first_message["content"]):
244                 logger.warning(
245                     "Session message history starts with orphaned toolResult with no preceding toolUse. "
246                     "This typically happens when messages are truncated due to pagination limits. "
247                     "Removing orphaned toolResult message to maintain valid conversation structure."
248                 )

222     def _fix_broken_tool_use(self, messages: list[Message]) -> list[Message]:
223         """Fix broken tool use/result pairs in message history.
224 
225         This method handles two issues:
226         1. Orphaned toolUse messages without corresponding toolResult.
227            Before 1.15.0, strands had a bug where they persisted sessions with a potentially broken messages array.
228            This method retroactively fixes that issue by adding a tool_result outside of session management.
229            After 1.15.0, this bug is no longer present.
230         2. Orphaned toolResult messages without corresponding toolUse (e.g., when pagination truncates messages)
231 
232         Args:
233             messages: The list of messages to fix
234             agent_id: The agent ID for fetching previous messages
235             removed_message_count: Number of messages removed by the conversation manager
236 
237         Returns:
238             Fixed list of messages with proper tool use/result pairs
239         """
240         # First, check if the oldest message has orphaned toolResult (no preceding toolUse) and remove it.
241         if messages:
242             first_message = messages[0]
243             if first_message["role"] == "user" and any("toolResult" in content for content in first_message["content"]):
244                 logger.warning(
245                     "Session message history starts with orphaned toolResult with no preceding toolUse. "
246                     "This typically happens when messages are truncated due to pagination limits. "
247                     "Removing orphaned toolResult message to maintain valid conversation structure."
248                 )
249                 messages.pop(0)
250 
251         # Then check for orphaned toolUse messages
252         for index, message in enumerate(messages):
253             # Check all but the latest message in the messages array
254             # The latest message being orphaned is handled in the agent class
255             if index + 1 < len(messages):
256                 if any("toolUse" in content for content in message["content"]):
257                     tool_use_ids = [
258                         content["toolUse"]["toolUseId"] for content in message["content"] if "toolUse" in content
259                     ]
260 
261                     # Check if there are more messages after the current toolUse message
262                     tool_result_ids = [
263                         content["toolResult"]["toolUseId"]
264                         for content in messages[index + 1]["content"]
265                         if "toolResult" in content
266                     ]
267 
268                     missing_tool_use_ids = list(set(tool_use_ids) - set(tool_result_ids))
269                     # If there are missing tool use ids, that means the messages history is broken
270                     if missing_tool_use_ids:
271                         logger.warning(
272                             "Session message history has an orphaned toolUse with no toolResult. "
273                             "Adding toolResult content blocks to create valid conversation."
274                         )
275                         # Create the missing toolResult content blocks
276                         missing_content_blocks = generate_missing_tool_result_content(missing_tool_use_ids)
277 
278                         if tool_result_ids:
279                             # If there were any toolResult ids, that means only some of the content blocks are missing
280                             messages[index + 1]["content"].extend(missing_content_blocks)
281                         else:
282                             # The message following the toolUse was not a toolResult, so lets insert it
283                             messages.insert(index + 1, {"role": "user", "content": missing_content_blocks})
284         return messages
